image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two stacked audio cassette tapes. The top cassette is white with a handwritten label featuring reversed or mirrored text (e.g., 'S.M.S. 1985'). The bottom cassette is black with a beige label strip containing large, spaced-out letters ('N', 'F', 'O', 'N', 'E'). Both cassettes show the standard rectangular shape, circular spool windows, and internal tape mechanisms. The image has a slightly grainy, vintage aesthetic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the top cassette label ('S.M.S. 1985' etc.) appears mirrored or reversed, which is a common AI artifact when generating text. It is legible as characters but semantically and orthographically incorrect for a standard label.

The letters 'N F O N E' on the bottom label have slightly irregular spacing and alignment, and the font style looks somewhat hand-drawn or inconsistently printed, lacking the crispness of mass-produced typography.
The left edge of the top cassette seems to blend slightly into the background or has a soft, undefined boundary compared to the sharper right edge, suggesting minor structural ambiguity.
